Launch tags:SaaS•Developer Tools•Artificial Intelligence [...] That's what we built Yedric to do. Yedric is an embeddable AI agent that turns what your app can already do into things users can simply ask for. You give Yedric access to your product knowledge, user context, and APIs, and he can actually get things done inside your app.

We originally built this technology for our own Shopify apps. We wanted users to be able to say things like "turn off email notifications" or "fix my broken integration" and have the app handle it for them instead of sending them through docs, support, or a maze of settings.
